# Fin Involvement Rate & AI Resolution Rate: 2026 plan estimate

## Targets

| Metric                                                      | Baseline     | End of 2026 target | End 2027 target |
| :---------------------------------------------------------- | :----------- | :----------------- | :-------------- |
| Fin involvement rate                                        | 13%          | **\~80%**    | **\-**    |
| AI resolution rate                                          | 70%          | **60-70%**   | **\-**    |
| **Overall AI resolution (involvement × resolution)** | **9%** | **\~50%**    | **\~80%** |

**Ceiling:** 18.7% of contacts are unreachable by Fin (internal CKO email, IM). The hard ceiling is \~81%. The 80% target is achievable; 100% is not.

**Why can’t AI (Fin and overall) resolution rate go higher in 2026?**

* We are tackling the big resolution rate opportunity areas/support debt in 2026, solving the long tail requires more detailed analysis to scope and plan for now, with diminishing returns as we look to increase overall resolution.
* We are targeting 80% overall AI resolution as goal, but this needs:
  * Solving for the unreachable contacts \~18%:
    * By removing internal queries (9%) being raised in first place (Project Horus & simpler knowledge access for Commercial should help this substantially)
    * Decision on APAC merchant IM solution (9%) \- unlikely we can ever put Fin on here as there are \~5-10 IM apps in use today across merchants.
  * Solving the long tail of support issues
    * Use our improved analytics insights to uncover, estimate and push issues to Product teams proactively vs reactively.
* We will draft a plan for this area as part of 2027 plans, with a provisional overall AI resolution goal of 80%.

## 2026 plan

**TLDR:**

* We have several levers for involvement & resolution rate increases to get us to our goal
* Most of our resolution rate levers have dependencies from Q3 onwards

**Caveat:**
Resolution rate drivers are estimated from support contact mix and gaps analysis from Q4 2025\. Does not account for any new spikes or change in contact mix in 2026\. Ballpark estimates are provided for each quarter which bakes in the drivers we expect. We plan to make analysis more accurate as part of ongoing support data insights (Reflex) work from Q2 onwards.

**BUT: Current issues and direction of travel are the same regardless.**
